crossRefs.note: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.

translations.web: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.
translations.bsb: And about four thousand men were present. And when Jesus had dismissed the crowd,
translations.kjv: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
translations.asv: And they were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
